Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.liskov

Class SurveySchedule

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.liskov.SurveySchedule
public class SurveySchedule extends Object
Decides whether a survey of a data store is due.

A data store that has never been surveyed is surveyed straight away. After that, the interval between surveys starts at the minimum interval and grows by a day each time a survey finds no change since the survey before it, up to the maximum interval. As soon as a survey finds a change, the interval drops back to the minimum and the cycle repeats. With the default limits, a data store that keeps changing is surveyed daily, and one that has stopped changing is surveyed after 1 day, then 2, then 3 and so on up to once a week.

Nothing about the schedule is stored. It is worked out from the survey history each time it is needed, so it survives a restart of the integration daemon. The history is only consulted when the answer depends on it - never before the minimum interval has passed, never once the maximum has, and otherwise only as far back as the time since the latest survey requires.

    • isSurveyDue

      public boolean isSurveyDue(Date latestSurveyTime, int completedSurveyCount, SurveySchedule.ChangeDetector changeDetector, long now) throws InvalidParameterException, PropertyServerException, UserNotAuthorizedException
      Determine whether a survey is due.

      The interval is the minimum plus a day for each of the most recent surveys in a row that found no change, up to the maximum. So with d whole days since the latest survey, the survey is due unless each of the latest (d - minimum + 1) completed surveys found no change since the one before it. The comparisons stop at the first change. A completed survey with no completed survey before it to compare with counts as a change, because there is no evidence yet that the data store is stable.
      Parameters:
      latestSurveyTime - when the latest survey started - completed or not - or null if there has never been one. Measuring from the latest attempt means a survey that keeps failing is retried at the minimum interval rather than on every refresh.
      completedSurveyCount - number of completed surveys available to the change detector
      changeDetector - compares a completed survey with the one before it
      now - the current time in milliseconds
      Returns:
      true if a survey should be requested
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - the parameters are invalid
      PropertyServerException - problem accessing the property server
      UserNotAuthorizedException - user is not authorized to issue this request
